categories.name: Reddit Points
categories.content: Reddit Community Points are blockchain tokens that are owned and controlled by a specific Reddit community. With these point tokens, a community member can own a piece of their favorite subreddit. The points can be earned through contributions in the community such as post creation, comments, and content moderations.

categories.name: Oracle
categories.content: Oracles are used by protocols in their smart contracts in order to obtain external data. This allows the closed-off blockchain environment to communicate with data points on the outside world. For example, a protocol offering synthetic Nasdaq-listed stock on the blockchain will need to pull external data from the stock market. With an oracle, the protocol will be able to do so.

categories.name: x402 Ecosystem
categories.content: x402 is an open protocol that defines an internet-native micropayment rail using HTTP 402 and stablecoins. It allows automated clients and AI agents to pay directly for APIs, data, and compute on demand, enabling real-time, low-friction transactions without intermediaries.
